answer: To secure an autonomous economy, we define verified work where an honest node commits 1 unit of compute to solve a unique task, while an attacker attempting to simulate 1,000 identities must expend 1,000 units, effectively making each task a harbor for verifiable authenticity. A verifier rejects any duplicate output signature and monitors for transition errors that indicate an island of fake state, ensuring no identity can clone work. If a zenith of inconsistent evidence appears, the node is banned without refund, assuming non-amortizable work tasks.
